turns.q: What if more than one item in my order is affected?
turns.replyTail: If more than one item is affected, start by checking whether your order shipped in multiple packages: - Review your tracking details on the carrier’s tracking page to confirm whether all items show as delivered (larger orders often ship separately, so some pieces may still be in transit and arrive within 1–2 business days). - Do a quick sweep around your home (front porch, side door, garage, carport). - Check with your neighbours in case a package was accepted or delivered next door by mistake.
